title: Chapter 95 An Xing'S Habit
content:
Chapter 95 An Xing'S Habit

Wanling Realm, inside the deserted city.

In a mansion with a slightly dim atmosphere.

"My lord, there is an emergency!"

Hearing the shout, An Xing, who was playing with the pink unicorn in the house, trembled all over, quickly stuffed it into his arms, and then walked quickly out of the house.

"What's going on?"

Looking at the root member who was kneeling on one knee outside the house and just bowed his head, An Xing said in a deep voice.

Actually disturbing him at this time, if it's nothing serious, don't blame him for being angry.

Sensing An Xing's unfriendly tone, the root member immediately broke out in a cold sweat.

"My lord, the Space-Time God Tower suddenly activated itself. I guess it should be the signal from the Lord of the City."

Hearing this, An Xing was shocked.

The signal from the Lord of the City!

Not daring to be careless, An Xing disappeared instantly.

At the same time, the entire deserted city noticed the unusual movement from the Space-Time God Tower.

A large number of people in the City Lord's Mansion have already gone to the Space-Time God Tower.

When An Xing arrived here, there were only a few people in front of the Space-Time God Tower, which shows how fast the message was transmitted.

Seeing the space-time tunnel in front of the Space-Time God Tower, An Xing looked solemn.

At this time, Gu Chen also walked over quickly from a distance.

"An Xing, what's going on?"

Gu Chen came to An Xing and said in a deep voice.

It has been a while since Lu Daosheng left the Wasteland City.

These days, there is no crisis in the Wasteland City, and they are all practicing in peace because of this.

With the accumulation of these terrifying resources in the Wasteland City, their practice speed has also broken through very quickly. At this moment, they have already far surpassed the strength of all living beings in the Ten Thousand Spirits Realm and have completely become a transcendent force.

Hearing Gu Chen's words, An Xing shook his head.

"I just came here, and I'm not very clear, but I guess this must be related to the City Lord. Let's wait and see."

Hearing this, Gu Chen nodded.

Soon, everyone came here.

Including Huang Shou, Yunqi, A Wei, Ouyang Yanqing and others, all came here.

Looking at the space-time tunnel, Ouyang Yanqing took the lead and said: "The place where this space-time tunnel leads to should be the location of the city lord."

Hearing Ouyang Yanqing's words, everyone wondered: "How do you know?"

Ouyang Yanqing smiled lightly and said: "Do you know how I came to Huangcheng? It was the city lord who used this space-time tower to open the space-time tunnel to send me here."

Hearing this, everyone nodded, and then said: "In this case, let's go in and find out."

This statement immediately attracted everyone's agreement.

Huang Shou was the first to rush in with a sword, followed by Yunqi.

Less than a moment later, only A Wei and An Xing were left in the high-level members of Huangcheng.

"Brother Wei, aren't you going in?"

An Xing looked at A Wei who was hesitant, stepped forward and smiled.

Glancing at An Xing, A Wei frowned and said, "What will happen to the Wasteland City if we all leave?"

It's no big deal if the Wasteland Guard Yunqi and others are gone from the city.

After all, the Wasteland City is now strong and they are no longer needed.

But the two of them are different. One is the leader of the Wasteland Guard and the other is the root leader.

They are responsible for maintaining the order and safety in the Wasteland City.

It can be said that neither of them is indispensable.

If the two of them leave now, what if the people below are not under their control and there is a mess?

If something really happens, it will be a big deal.

He doesn't want to disappoint the city lord.

After hearing A Wei's words, An Xing smiled and said, "Then the two of us will wait for a while."

After that, An Xing patted A Wei and sat cross-legged on the ground.

And around, countless strong men in the city lord's mansion were paying attention to the time tunnel, and from time to time they glanced at A Wei and An Xing.

Everyone knew A Wei.

But for An Xing, even the senior members of the City Lord's Mansion could not recognize him.

Those with low strength could not even see An Xing's face, but only a hazy one.

The other side of the space-time tunnel.

Buzz——

As the space-time tunnel trembled, the next moment, several figures rushed out of the space-time tunnel one after another.

The people of Huang Shou felt their eyes light up, and their bodies involuntarily rushed forward.

"Fuck!"

Bang bang bang!

Without exception, Huang Shou and his men all fell to the ground.

Seeing this scene, Lu Daosheng and his men were stunned, and for a moment, the scene became extremely awkward.

The distance was too far, so the space-time tunnel was slightly unstable, but it was not a big problem.

Huang Shou and his men quickly stood up, and then respectfully said to Lu Daosheng: "Subordinates, meet the Lord City Lord!"

But their faces were all a little ugly.

Retracting his thoughts, Lu Daosheng nodded.

"Thank you for your hard work these days."

Sweeping his eyes over Huang Shou and the others, their strength has improved greatly.

Huang Shou has now reached the Divine Realm and officially entered the Divine Realm, while the others are at least at the Divine Realm.

This level of strength is already very good.

Next, I just need to give them a break and give them some special training. I believe their strength will catch up soon.

At the same time, Yu Qingfeng and Jiang Bei beside Lu Daosheng were also looking at Huang Shou and the others.

Although their strength is far inferior to theirs now, each of them is a good seedling with a solid foundation. The key is that these are all Lu Daosheng's men, and they are all confidants at a glance.

It is probably only a matter of time before we can be on par with them in the future.

At this time, Lu Daosheng suddenly asked: "Where are Awei and Anxing?"

Huang Shou and others are here, but Awei and Anxing are missing.

Huangcheng can't be without them now.

Lu Daosheng values these two people very much.

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words, Huang Shou Gu Chen and others were stunned, and immediately realized that they were really missing.

"Lord City Lord, the two of them should still be in Huangcheng."

Gu Chen stepped forward and said.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng pondered for a moment, and then he understood.

These two guys are very responsible.

"Awei, Anxing."

Lu Daosheng's thoughts moved slightly, and Awei and the other side of the time-space tunnel immediately heard Lu Daosheng's words.

"It's Lord City Lord!"

Immediately, the two of them stood up quickly, looking respectfully in the direction of the time-space tunnel.

At this time, Lu Daosheng's voice continued to ring from his ears.

"Let's put aside the things over there for now and come here first."

Hearing this, the two of them nodded without hesitation and said, "Yes, Lord City Lord."

"Let's go."

An Xing looked at A Wei and said.

A Wei nodded.

Without any extra nonsense, the two of them went straight into the space-time tunnel.

As their eyes lit up, the environment around them suddenly changed dramatically.

However, before they could get excited, they suddenly felt their center of gravity was unstable.

"Damn!"

Bang Bang!

As expected, the two of them flew out of the space-time tunnel just like Huang Shou and others.

Face to face. . .

What was even more surprising was that a pink unicorn suddenly flew out of An Xing's arms and fell at Lu Xue's feet.

Huang Shou and others had been waiting to see the joke.

Seeing this scene, the scene was silent for a long time, and then there was a crazy laugh.

At this time, Lu Xue picked up the pink unicorn at her feet, and her expression suddenly brightened.

"Tsk, it's strawberry flavored."
